cards.gloss_en: a lack or shortage of something
cards.ex_en: There was a scarcity of clean water after the flood.
cards.ex_cn: 洪水过后干净的水很匮乏。

cards.gloss_en: having a pleasant, appetizing taste
cards.ex_en: The soup smelled savoury and warm.
cards.ex_cn: 汤闻起来美味又温暖。

cards.gloss_en: feeling hot and ill with a fever
cards.ex_en: The sick boy felt feverish all night.
cards.ex_cn: 那生病的男孩整夜发烧。

cards.gloss_en: continuing without any break or stop
cards.ex_en: We enjoyed three uninterrupted hours of quiet.
cards.ex_cn: 我们享受了三个小时不间断的安静。

cards.gloss_en: showing no respect for God or holy things
cards.ex_en: The old sailor was known for his profane talk.
cards.ex_cn: 那老水手以出言不敬闻名。

cards.gloss_en: done without care or thought
cards.ex_en: One unthinking word can hurt a friend.
cards.ex_cn: 一句不经思考的话就能伤到朋友。

cards.gloss_en: refusing to obey rules or authority
cards.ex_en: The rebellious student ignored every rule.
cards.ex_cn: 那个叛逆的学生无视一切规矩。

cards.gloss_en: wanting or eating large amounts eagerly
cards.ex_en: He had a voracious appetite after the hike.
cards.ex_cn: 远足后他胃口极大。

cards.gloss_en: not thinking of others or of consequences
cards.ex_en: It was thoughtless of him to forget her birthday.
cards.ex_cn: 他忘了她生日,真是欠考虑。

cards.gloss_en: a rough, cruel person or wild animal
cards.ex_en: The man fought like a brute.
cards.ex_cn: 那人打起架来像头野兽。

cards.gloss_en: in a fair and respectable way
cards.ex_en: He always behaves honourably toward others.
cards.ex_cn: 他待人一贯正直。

cards.gloss_en: in a kind and generous way
cards.ex_en: She spoke charitably about her rivals.
cards.ex_cn: 她宽厚地谈及对手。

cards.gloss_en: to (old-fashioned word)
cards.ex_en: He gave his coat unto the poor man.
cards.ex_cn: 他把外衣给了那个穷人。

cards.gloss_en: suffering from pain, illness or trouble
cards.ex_en: She was afflicted with a bad cough.
cards.ex_cn: 她受严重咳嗽折磨。

cards.gloss_en: forced out of someone by pressure or pain
cards.ex_en: The pain extorted a cry from him.
cards.ex_cn: 疼痛逼得他喊出声来。

cards.gloss_en: a sudden cry showing strong feeling
cards.ex_en: She gave an exclamation of surprise.
cards.ex_cn: 她惊呼一声。

cards.gloss_en: shivering with fever, as in malaria
cards.ex_en: An aguish chill ran through his body.
cards.ex_cn: 一阵疟疾般的寒战传遍他全身。

cards.gloss_en: of or like a wild, savage animal
cards.ex_en: The film showed the brutal side of nature.
cards.ex_cn: 影片展现了自然界兽性的一面。

cards.gloss_en: the whole extent or area of something
cards.ex_en: No creature escapes the circuit of the law.
cards.ex_cn: 无一生灵逃得出律法的范围。

cards.gloss_en: to say the opposite of something
cards.ex_en: His actions contradict his promises.
cards.ex_cn: 他的行为与承诺相矛盾。

cards.gloss_en: spoke with disrespect about God
cards.ex_en: The crowd thought he had blasphemed.
cards.ex_cn: 众人认为他亵渎了神明。

cards.gloss_en: it seemed to me (old word)
cards.ex_en: Methought I heard a distant bell.
cards.ex_cn: 我仿佛听见远处的钟声。

cards.gloss_en: wasted or used badly
cards.ex_en: He regretted his misspent youth.
cards.ex_cn: 他为虚度的青春懊悔。

cards.gloss_en: medicine, especially a laxative
cards.ex_en: The doctor gave him some bitter physic.
cards.ex_cn: 医生给了他些苦药。

cards.gloss_en: the state of being unable to breathe
cards.ex_en: Smoke filled the room and caused suffocation.
cards.ex_cn: 烟雾弥漫,令人窒息。

cards.gloss_en: a small wild sea goose
cards.ex_en: A brandgoose flew low over the water.
cards.ex_cn: 一只黑雁低掠水面。

cards.gloss_en: paid no attention to
cards.ex_en: She disregarded his rude remark.
cards.ex_cn: 她没理会他无礼的话。

cards.gloss_en: forced a rule or task on someone
cards.ex_en: The teacher imposed a strict rule.
cards.ex_cn: 老师定下一条严格规矩。

cards.gloss_en: luckily, as if guided by fate
cards.ex_en: Providentially, help arrived just in time.
cards.ex_cn: 天意般地,救援及时赶到。

cards.gloss_en: the forgiveness of sins or debts
cards.ex_en: The prisoner prayed for remission.
cards.ex_cn: 囚犯祈求赦免。

cards.gloss_en: to understand words in a certain way
cards.ex_en: Don't construe my silence as agreement.
cards.ex_cn: 别把我的沉默理解为同意。

cards.gloss_en: very harmful, often in a hidden way
cards.ex_en: Damp air was pernicious to his health.
cards.ex_cn: 潮湿空气对他健康有害。

cards.gloss_en: a tropical root used to make bread
cards.ex_en: They dug up cassava to make flour.
cards.ex_cn: 他们挖出木薯做面粉。

cards.gloss_en: spiky plants used for medicine
cards.ex_en: Rows of aloes grew along the sandy path.
cards.ex_cn: 沙径旁长着一排排芦荟。

cards.gloss_en: the growing of crops or plants
cards.ex_en: The land needs careful cultivation.
cards.ex_cn: 这片土地需要精心耕种。

cards.gloss_en: illnesses that cause loose bowels
cards.ex_en: Bad water gave the sailors fluxes.
cards.ex_cn: 坏水让水手们患上痢疾。

cards.gloss_en: fresh green plants and grass
cards.ex_en: The valley was full of soft verdure.
cards.ex_cn: 山谷里满是柔嫩的青翠草木。

cards.gloss_en: in a way impossible to protect or defend
cards.ex_en: The camp lay indefensibly open on all sides.
cards.ex_cn: 营地四面难以设防。

cards.gloss_en: a large lemon-like citrus fruit
cards.ex_en: She candied the thick citron peel.
cards.ex_cn: 她把厚厚的香橼皮做成蜜饯。

cards.gloss_en: to be placed in a particular spot
cards.ex_en: The hut was situate on a low hill.
cards.ex_cn: 那小屋坐落在矮丘上。

cards.gloss_en: to expect something to happen
cards.ex_en: We anticipate rain this evening.
cards.ex_cn: 我们预料今晚有雨。

cards.gloss_en: not likely to be true or happen
cards.ex_en: It seemed improbable that help would come.
cards.ex_cn: 救援似乎不大可能到来。

cards.gloss_en: filled with love or delight for something
cards.ex_en: He was enamoured of the quiet island.
cards.ex_cn: 他迷恋上了这座宁静的小岛。

cards.gloss_en: annoyed someone again and again
cards.ex_en: Flies pestered us all afternoon.
cards.ex_cn: 苍蝇烦扰了我们一下午。

cards.gloss_en: going on without stopping
cards.ex_en: The incessant rain kept us indoors.
cards.ex_cn: 不停的雨把我们困在屋里。

cards.gloss_en: controlled or made regular
cards.ex_en: He regulated his meals by the sun.
cards.ex_cn: 他按太阳安排三餐。

cards.gloss_en: lying face down in worship or respect
cards.ex_en: The pilgrims were prostrating before the altar.
cards.ex_cn: 朝圣者俯伏在祭坛前。

cards.gloss_en: to tell a story or account
cards.ex_en: He began to relate his strange adventure.
cards.ex_cn: 他开始讲述他离奇的经历。

cards.gloss_en: a long period with little or no rain
cards.ex_en: The crops died in the long drought.
cards.ex_cn: 庄稼在长期干旱中枯死。

cards.gloss_en: of or happening in spring
cards.ex_en: Vernal flowers covered the hillside.
cards.ex_cn: 春天的花开满了山坡。

cards.gloss_en: a tree with long thin bending branches
cards.ex_en: A willow leaned over the small pond.
cards.ex_cn: 一棵柳树斜倚在小池塘上。

cards.gloss_en: cutting off branches from a tree
cards.ex_en: He was lopping the low branches with an axe.
cards.ex_cn: 他正用斧头砍去低垂的枝条。

cards.gloss_en: cut back a plant to help it grow
cards.ex_en: She pruned the roses in early spring.
cards.ex_cn: 她在早春修剪玫瑰。

cards.gloss_en: too eager to give orders or help
cards.ex_en: The officious clerk kept correcting everyone.
cards.ex_cn: 那爱多事的职员老是纠正每个人。

cards.gloss_en: low willow trees or bushes
cards.ex_en: Thin sallows grew by the damp ditch.
cards.ex_cn: 潮湿的沟边长着细瘦的黄花柳。

cards.gloss_en: willow twigs used for weaving baskets
cards.ex_en: He wove a basket from fresh osiers.
cards.ex_cn: 他用新鲜的柳条编了个篮子。

cards.gloss_en: useful and able to be used well
cards.ex_en: The old boots were still serviceable.
cards.ex_cn: 那双旧靴子仍然耐用。

cards.gloss_en: caught sight of something far off
cards.ex_en: He descried a sail on the horizon.
cards.ex_cn: 他望见地平线上有一片帆。

cards.gloss_en: quietly agreed without objecting
cards.ex_en: She acquiesced to the new plan.
cards.ex_cn: 她默许了这个新计划。

cards.gloss_en: to pass by or across again
cards.ex_en: The ferry would repass the river at noon.
cards.ex_cn: 渡船正午会再渡过河去。

cards.gloss_en: very careful and needing much effort
cards.ex_en: The model took painstaking work to finish.
cards.ex_cn: 这个模型做起来煞费苦心。

cards.gloss_en: willing to take risks; bold
cards.ex_en: The venturous boy climbed the tallest tree.
cards.ex_cn: 那个大胆的男孩爬上了最高的树。

cards.gloss_en: very bad and causing sorrow
cards.ex_en: The prisoners lived in deplorable conditions.
cards.ex_cn: 囚犯们生活在悲惨的境况中。

cards.gloss_en: completely and directly, all at once
cards.ex_en: He walked ten miles outright without resting.
cards.ex_cn: 他一口气走了十英里没歇脚。

cards.gloss_en: to entertain or feast oneself well
cards.ex_en: They regaled the guests with fine food.
cards.ex_cn: 他们用美食款待客人。

cards.gloss_en: shut an animal in a small enclosure
cards.ex_en: The farmer penned the sheep for the night.
cards.ex_cn: 农夫把羊圈起来过夜。

cards.gloss_en: low woody plants smaller than trees
cards.ex_en: Small shrubs grew along the fence.
cards.ex_cn: 篱笆边长着矮小的灌木。

cards.gloss_en: tame animals kept about the home
cards.ex_en: He fed his domestics before sunset.
cards.ex_cn: 他在日落前喂了自家的牲畜。

cards.gloss_en: things that are lacking or missing
cards.ex_en: The plan had several serious deficiencies.
cards.ex_cn: 这个计划有几处严重缺陷。

cards.gloss_en: can (old form used with thou)
cards.ex_en: Canst thou lift this heavy stone?
cards.ex_cn: 你能搬起这块重石吗?

cards.gloss_en: someone who pretends to be good
cards.ex_en: The hypocrite praised honesty but lied daily.
cards.ex_cn: 那伪君子口称诚实却天天撒谎。

cards.gloss_cn: (古)可以、也许(may 的第二人称)
cards.gloss_en: may (old form used with thou)
cards.ex_en: Thou mayest rest here tonight.
cards.ex_cn: 你今晚可以在此歇息。

cards.gloss_en: would (old form used with thou)
cards.ex_en: Wouldst thou follow me into the storm?
cards.ex_cn: 你愿随我闯入风暴吗?

cards.gloss_en: three times
cards.ex_en: He knocked thrice at the wooden door.
cards.ex_cn: 他在木门上敲了三下。

cards.gloss_en: the quality of needing hard, tiring work
cards.ex_en: The laboriousness of the task wore him out.
cards.ex_cn: 这活的辛劳把他累垮了。

cards.gloss_en: workers who saw wood into planks
cards.ex_en: Two sawyers cut the log into boards.
cards.ex_cn: 两个锯木工把原木锯成木板。

cards.gloss_en: spread dung on soil to enrich it
cards.ex_en: He manured the field before planting.
cards.ex_cn: 他种地前先施了肥。

cards.gloss_en: suitable for growing crops
cards.ex_en: Only a small patch of arable land remained.
cards.ex_cn: 只剩下一小块可耕地。

cards.gloss_en: quickly and steadily
cards.ex_en: The work went on apace all summer.
cards.ex_cn: 整个夏天工作进展迅速。

cards.gloss_cn: 茁壮成长(thrive 的过去式)
cards.gloss_en: grew strong and healthy
cards.ex_en: The young plants throve in the warm soil.
cards.ex_cn: 幼苗在温暖的土里茁壮成长。

cards.gloss_en: well known for something bad
cards.ex_en: The road was notorious for accidents.
cards.ex_cn: 那条路以事故频发而臭名昭著。

cards.gloss_en: a tool with a long curved blade for cutting grass
cards.ex_en: The farmer swung his scythe through the tall grass.
cards.ex_cn: 农夫挥动大镰刀割过高草。

cards.gloss_en: a short curved blade for cutting crops
cards.ex_en: She cut the wheat with a small sickle.
cards.ex_cn: 她用小镰刀割麦子。

cards.gloss_en: swords with wide, heavy blades
cards.ex_en: The soldiers carried heavy broadswords.
cards.ex_cn: 士兵们带着沉重的阔刃大刀。

cards.gloss_en: a farm tool for turning up soil
cards.ex_en: The ox pulled the heavy plough.
cards.ex_cn: 牛拉着沉重的犁。

cards.gloss_en: a toothed tool for gathering or smoothing
cards.ex_en: He smoothed the soil with a wooden rake.
cards.ex_cn: 他用木耙把土耙平。

cards.gloss_en: to cut down grass or grain
cards.ex_en: It was time to mow the ripe barley.
cards.ex_cn: 到了收割成熟大麦的时候。

cards.gloss_en: to cut and gather a crop
cards.ex_en: The farmers reaped the wheat in autumn.
cards.ex_cn: 农夫们在秋天收割小麦。

cards.gloss_en: the dry husks separated from grain
cards.ex_en: The wind blew the chaff away from the grain.
cards.ex_cn: 风把谷壳从谷粒中吹走。

cards.gloss_en: a unit of land area
cards.ex_en: They cleared an acre of forest for farming.
cards.ex_cn: 他们清出一英亩林地来耕种。

cards.gloss_en: having an ugly or wrong shape
cards.ex_en: The clay pot came out lumpy and misshapen.
cards.ex_cn: 那陶罐做出来疙疙瘩瘩,走了样。

cards.gloss_en: large jugs for holding water
cards.ex_en: She filled two pitchers at the well.
cards.ex_cn: 她在井边装满了两个大水罐。

cards.gloss_en: an oven for baking clay or bricks
cards.ex_en: The potter fired the bowls in a hot kiln.
cards.ex_cn: 陶工在炽热的窑里烧制碗。

cards.gloss_en: people who make pots from clay
cards.ex_en: The village potters shaped jars all day.
cards.ex_cn: 村里的陶工整天捏制陶罐。

cards.gloss_en: coating pottery with a shiny finish
cards.ex_en: Glazing makes the bowl smooth and shiny.
cards.ex_cn: 上釉使碗光滑发亮。

cards.gloss_en: needed for a purpose
cards.ex_en: He lacked the requisite tools for the job.
cards.ex_cn: 他缺少这活所需的工具。

cards.gloss_en: to crush by pounding hard
cards.ex_en: She used a pestle to stamp the grain.
cards.ex_cn: 她用杵把谷子捣碎。
